purpose: All-query/all-subject nucleotide HSP audit on unchanged receptor-cohort records and original references; stop before aggregation or grouping
record_policy: Preserve every separate normalized DNA record, neutral ID, source accession, original record order and ambiguous base. Never concatenate records, trim or filter from annotation/phenotype. Targets use source_record_id equal to original frozen accession.
container_key_rule: source:<primary_id> versus reference:<T7-or-T3>; published and original-reference T7/T3 remain distinct nodes
blastn_format: 7 qseqid sseqid evalue bitscore qlen slen qstart qend sstart send qseq sseq nident gaps
command_templates: 7 qseqid sseqid evalue bitscore qlen slen qstart qend sstart send qseq sseq nident gaps

completion_policy.hit_rows: Every declared per-query HSP count must equal parsed raw rows
completion_policy.self_controls: Require at least one schema/coordinate-validated query=subject HSP for each of all270record IDs; do not impose or normalize self similarity to100%
completion_policy.streaming: Preserve HSP order and all fourteen literal fields in headerless numeric TSV; validate IDs, declared lengths, finite scores, alignment spans and gap counts without recomputing ambiguous-base identities

monitoring: Wait/poll the same process at30second intervals with no automatic timeout, killing, resubmission or restart
resource_scope: Serial command CPU/time and cumulative direct-child peak RSS, not aggregate workflow memory
stops_after: Validated HSP output only. Container offsets/aggregation, original-R comparison, symmetric similarities, whole-genome graph/group exclusions and admission require separate frozen audits.
